name: Starfighter Arena
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A multiplayer-only space battle: fly a ship designed in Starfighter Ship Creator and manage your energy as you move and shoot. Arrows to move, buttons for radar and fire.

descriptions.en: A multiplayer-only space battle: fly a ship designed in Starfighter Ship Creator and manage your energy as you move and shoot. Arrows to move, buttons for radar and fire.
descriptions.it: Battaglia spaziale solo multigiocatore: pilota la nave creata con Starfighter Ship Creator e gestisci l'energia mentre ti muovi e spari. Frecce per muoverti, pulsanti per radar e fuoco.
